column1: > This file is a parallel corpus written for CS 687. Each line holds one English sentence and its Turkish translation, separated by a tab character. Lines beginning with a greater-than sign are comments and are skipped by the loader.

> These sentences were written for this course rather than taken from an existing corpus, so they may be copied, modified, and redistributed freely by anyone taking or teaching CS 687. They deliberately mix everyday vocabulary with academic and technical vocabulary, and they include many Turkish words that carry several suffixes, because the fertility effect is clearest exactly there.
> To extend this file, simply add lines in the same format. Roughly one hundred pairs is enough for a stable measurement; more pairs tighten the estimate.
The model reads the text and predicts the next word.
